ops: 38). Before this release, the action installed a `commit-msg` hook (Conventional Commits only) and a `prepare-commit-msg` hook (`Refs #<first number in the branch name>`) in your checkout. Now pi follows your repository's own conventions: your git hooks, `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`. If you want a commit format, enforce it yourself, for example with commitlint in CI (hooks can be skipped with `--no-verify`).
